extracted.intended_audience: governments, development partners, donors, and rural development practitioners interested in IFAD programmes
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-level description of IFAD's priorities, operational principles and areas of work that guide programme design, financing and evaluation. Useful for partners, governments and applicants seeking to align projects with IFAD's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investing in rural people
rubrics_metrics.description: Simply put, IFAD invests in rural people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD does this by financing programmes, measuring results, innovating and working with rural people themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmes for progress (loans and grants)
rubrics_metrics.description: We reduce poverty, improve nutrition and increase food production by providing loans and grants that transform rural communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD develops solutions with governments and rural people so investments solve issues at hand while laying foundations for thriving rural economies in the long term.

rubrics_metrics.name: People-centred development
rubrics_metrics.description: For rural people, by rural people — the more engaged rural people are as decision-makers, the greater our impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A people-centred approach involves engaging rural people as decision-makers in project design and implementation to increase effectiveness and sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority to vulnerable and marginalised groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Our investments support those most vulnerable, including women, youth, Indigenous Peoples and persons with disabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeting these groups helps projects not only grow incomes but also promote gender equality and inclusiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making finance work for those who need it most
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide financing to governments at favourable terms so they can transform their economies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD explores new financing mechanisms and empowers rural communities to flourish through appropriate financial terms and instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measuring what matters / Managing for results
rubrics_metrics.description: To understand whether IFAD is making a difference, we systematically measure results, including through impact assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each project includes a monitoring and evaluation system for collecting data; the Independent Office of Evaluation conducts independent project evaluations which offer additional insights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embracing innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: In an increasingly complex world, we cannot rely on conventional approaches to respond to today’s challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD tests and learns to deliver better results; it co-finances proven innovations that can be scaled up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transforming food systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforming food systems is a core way IFAD works to achieve impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should contribute to making food systems more sustainable, equitable and resilient as part of IFAD's programmatic objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting transformative policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Support transformative policies that enable rural development and systemic change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD works with governments and partners to shape policy environments that sustain programme outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting South–South and triangular cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote South–South and triangular cooperation as a mechanism for sharing solutions and scaling impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFAD facilitates exchange and collaboration among countries and partners to replicate proven approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Empowering rural people (and sub-groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Empowering rural people is an action area covering rural women, rural youth, Indigenous Peoples and persons with disabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interventions should build capabilities, leadership and inclusion for these groups within rural economies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Protecting the environment (climate and biodiversity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Climate and environment, and biodiversity are core action areas for protecting natural assets that livelihoods depend on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should integrate climate resilience and biodiversity conservation into rural development interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Enhancing livelihoods and markets
rubrics_metrics.description: Work on the private sector, rural finance, and markets and value chains to enhance livelihoods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interventions should strengthen market access, value chains and financial inclusion to increase rural incomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Managing land and its resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Managing land and its resources is an explicit area of work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should support sustainable land management and tenure approaches to secure livelihoods and productivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Promoting sustainable farming (water, crops, livestock, fisheries and aquaculture)
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote sustainable farming across water, crops, livestock and fisheries and aquaculture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support to production systems should emphasize sustainability, higher productivity and resilience across these sub-sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action area: Building resilience (institutions, remittances, nutrition, fragile contexts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Building resilience includes strengthening rural institutions and organizations, leveraging remittances, improving nutrition and addressing fragile contexts and crises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should increase the ability of communities and systems to withstand shocks and sustain development gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Knowledge & Data to inform programmes
rubrics_metrics.description: Research, reports, position papers, practical tools and e-learning support IFAD's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use evidence and data (impact assessments, research outputs, practical tools) to inform design, implementation and scaling of interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results Management Framework / PRISMA Dashboard
rubrics_metrics.description: IFAD uses a Results Management Framework and PRISMA Dashboard to track and report performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and programmes are expected to align with IFAD's results framework and reporting mechanisms to demonstrate outcomes and impacts.
